title_ko: 각국 33인 세계희망선언문 채택 서명자 선정 기준
title_en: 33 Representatives per Country — Selection Criteria for Signatories of the World Hope Declaration
note_ko: 선정 기준은 예시이며 확정 시 변경될 수 있습니다.
note_en: These criteria are examples and may change when finalized.
source: 의뢰인 자료(선정 기준표 이미지) 전사. 오기 정정: '국위양 (Cotribiion)'→'국위선양 (National Prestige)', '초·중·교'→'초·중·고'. 영문 분야명은 인포그래픽 자료 기준, 세부 분야·기준 영문은 번역 초안.

rows.criteria_ko: 사회문제 해결과 공익활동에 영향력이 있는 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person with influence in solving social problems and public-interest work

rows.criteria_ko: 갈등해결, 지역사회 화합과 중재에 기여한 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who contributed to conflict resolution, community harmony and mediation

rows.criteria_ko: 언론·미디어를 통해 사회에 선한 영향을 준 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who has had a good influence on society through the press and media

rows.criteria_ko: 국가 위상을 높인 국제 스포츠 분야 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person in international sports who raised the nation's standing
A person who enhanced the nation's image through international exchange and public diplomacy

rows.criteria_ko: 유엔 및 국제기구 활동에 기여한 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who contributed to the work of the UN and international organizations

rows.criteria_ko: 초·중·고 교육 현장에서 모범이 된 교육자
rows.criteria_en: An educator who has been a model in primary and secondary schools

rows.criteria_ko: 대학 교육과 연구로 사회에 기여한 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who contributed to society through university teaching and research
A person dedicated to character, creativity and holistic education
A person who has had a good influence through popular culture

rows.criteria_ko: 음악을 통해 희망과 감동을 전한 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who has brought hope and inspiration through music
A person who contributed to the human spirit through literature and publishing

rows.criteria_ko: 기독교 분야에서 사랑과 봉사로 모범이 된 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who has been a model of love and service in Christianity

rows.criteria_ko: 천주교 분야에서 평화와 인류화합에 기여한 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who contributed to peace and human harmony in Catholicism

rows.criteria_ko: 불교 분야에서 자비와 생명존중을 실천한 인물
rows.criteria_en: A person who practiced compassion and respect for life in Buddhism
A business leader who contributed to society and national development through innovative management
A worker recognized for diligence and example in the workplace
A person who contributed to society in distribution and services
A police officer dedicated to public order and citizens' safety
A soldier dedicated to national security and keeping peace
A firefighter who protects lives through disaster rescue
A doctor who contributed to medical service and human health
A nurse who practiced respect for life through nursing and care
A Korean-medicine doctor who contributed to public health through traditional medicine
A person working in primary industries such as agriculture
A person working in fishing and fisheries
A person working in mining, manufacturing and other industrial sites
An ordinary citizen who is a model in the community
A citizen who embraces diverse cultures and social groups
A student who is an example through sharing and service
A cabinet member who contributed to national policy and public service
A public official dedicated to administration, local government and the public sector
An incumbent head of state who contributed to the nation and to peace for humanity
